title: LiveFoley: Dynamic Real-Time Video-to-Audio Generation for Immersive Interactive Worlds
author: Yusheng Dai, Vladimir Iashin, Kangdi Wang, Yuxuan Jiang et al.
description: Streaming video-to-audio (V2A) generation is essential for immersive interactive applications. However, real-time constraints leave existing streaming V2A methods far behind offline models: (1) visual frontends shrink their receptive fields to cut look-ahead latency, severely degrading audio-visual alignment; (2)…
summary: Streaming video-to-audio (V2A) generation is essential for immersive interactive applications. To this end, we present LiveFoley, a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that addresses both bottlenecks with imperceptible latency.
takeaways: To this end, we present LiveFoley, a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that addresses both bottlenecks with imperceptible latency.
For the audio backend, we explore widening the denoising window of the local diffusion transformer (LocDiT) head in two temporal directions.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiveFoley matches offline models in temporal alignment and leads streaming systems in generation quality.
